name: Tavily Web Search
description: Direct REST API connector for Tavily search, designed for AI applications. Returns ranked sources and extracted content. Requires a Tavily API key.

credentialFields.label: Tavily API key
credentialFields.help: Create an API key in your Tavily account. Keep it private.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web using Tavily's AI-oriented search API. Returns relevant source URLs, content snippets and optional synthesized answer.

query.description: Search terms or a natural-language question.

permissions.description: Sends the search query and configured search options to the provider over HTTPS.
Reads the search result titles, snippets, URLs and metadata returned by the provider.
